notes.title: Midnight Shift Rev1.3a
notes.content:
Midnight Shift Rev1.3a
Patch Notes

Updates & Fixes:

Fixes:

[olist]
 Reworked sliding door trigger/interaction script.  Sliding doors will now behave more realistic and trigger the close animation only when there is none standing in its detection area.  Also, the doors open animation will not trigger if the doors are already open.
 Reworked the rain, rain splash and cloud particles systems for better game performance.
 Reworked bulb replacement task script.  The man's bathroom light bulb task would occasionally bug if the player dropped the bulb making it impossible for the player to complete the task.
[/olist]

notes.title: Midnight Shift Rev1.2c
notes.content:
Midnight Shift Rev1.2c

Updates & Fixes:

Fixes:

Fixed a bugged that caused the buttons of the "Main Menu" to not work.  With this fix the players are now able to view the "Options" and "Credits" menus from the "Main Menu" screen as intended.
